starting-out-talking-to-elder-raley.speaker: Elder Raley
starting-out-talking-to-elder-raley.text: Welcome back, [player name]. You haven't seen Floopa, have you? She really should be resting, but she seems to have wandered off somewhere.

starting-out-talking-to-elder-raley.player: I'm afraid not. Should I go and look for her?

starting-out-talking-to-elder-raley.speaker: Elder Raley
starting-out-talking-to-elder-raley.text: Well, you really shouldn't worry yourself, [player name]. However, if you did want to go and find her, I would be very grateful.

steps.player: I'm happy to have a look around. Any ideas on where I should start looking?

steps.speaker: Elder Raley
steps.text: Well, she can't have gone too far. Perhaps you should ask if anyone has seen her around town.

steps.player: Sounds like a plan. I'll get to it.
Actually, I've got something I need to do right now. Sorry about that.

steps.speaker: Elder Raley
steps.text: It's not a problem. I'm sure she'll be back soon.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-r.speaker: Elder Raley
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-r.text: Welcome back, [player name]. Any luck finding Floopa?

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-r.speaker: Elder Raley
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-r.text: I'm sure she hasn't gone far. Perhaps you should ask if anyone has seen her around town.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-mag.speaker: Mag
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-mag.text: Welcome to Elder Raley's Herblore Stall. Would you like to buy some herblore supplies?

steps.speaker: Mag
steps.text: Floopa? Yes, I did see her earlier. It looked like she was heading towards the Sacred Grove in the middle of the island.

steps.player: Perfect, thank you. I'll head over there and see if I can find her.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-c.speaker: Elder Coco
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-c.text: Hello there. Can I interest you in some crafting supplies?

steps.speaker: Elder Coco
steps.text: Floopa? Yes, I did see her earlier. It looked like she was heading towards the Sacred Grove in the middle of the island.

steps.player: Perfect, thank you. I'll head over there and see if I can find her.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-s.text: Human. Do you wish to hunt? If so, I have supplies for you.

steps.speaker: Elder Strom
steps.text: Yes, I saw her heading towards the Sacred Grove in the centre of the island earlier.

steps.player: Perfect, thank you. I'll head over there and see if I can find her.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.speaker: Elder Krill
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.text: Hello there, human. Interested in some fish? Or maybe you need some fishing supplies?

steps.speaker: Elder Krill
steps.text: Floopa? Yes, I did see her earlier. It looked like she was heading towards the Sacred Grove in the middle of the island.

steps.player: Perfect, thank you. I'll head over there and see if I can find her.

options.text: Do you often sell to humans?

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-b.speaker: Elder Blunn
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-b.text: Ah, human. Are you in need of a spear or shield?

steps.speaker: Elder Blunn
steps.text: Yes, I saw her heading towards the Sacred Grove in the centre of the island earlier.

steps.player: Perfect, thank you. I'll head over there and see if I can find her.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-dalna.player: Perfect, thank you. I'll head over there and see if I can find her.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-t.speaker: Elder Torgan
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-t.text: Yes, I saw her heading towards the Sacred Grove in the centre of the island earlier.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-t.player: Perfect, thank you. I'll head over there and see if I can find her.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-amma.text: I believe I did see her earlier. She looked as though she was heading to the Sacred Grove in the centre of the island.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-amma.player: Perfect, thank you. I'll head over there and see if I can find her.

options.text: Would you look after my crops for me?

steps.text: I believe I did see her earlier. She looked as though she was heading to the Sacred Grove in the centre of the island.

steps.player: Perfect, thank you. I'll head over there and see if I can find her.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-finn.speaker: Finn
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-finn.text: Yes, I saw her heading towards the Sacred Grove in the centre of the island earlier.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-finn.player: Perfect, thank you. I'll head over there and see if I can find her.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.player: Hello there. I'm looking for Floopa.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.speaker: Elder Katt
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.text: Floopa? Yes, she's in the Grove right now.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.player: Would it be possible to speak to her?

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.speaker: Elder Katt
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.text: Well, the Grove is normally for tortugans only, but if you just want to speak to Floopa, I suppose I can let you enter as long as you promise not to chop down any of the camphor trees.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.speaker: Elder Katt
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.text: Very. Camphor trees play a key role in the Trial by Water so it is essential we look after them. Their wood is also highly desirable for all sorts of other purposes.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.speaker: Elder Katt
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.text: However, the trees are very rare and hard to grow. Our island is the only place you'll find them, but even then there's very few outside the Grove.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.player: I see. Well, I promise not to chop any of them down.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.speaker: Elder Katt
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-k.text: Thank you, human. In that case, you may head on in.

the-search-for-floopa-attempting-to-chop.speaker: Elder Katt
the-search-for-floopa-attempting-to-chop.text: Excuse me! You don't have permission to touch those trees!

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: [player name]? What are you doing here?

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.player: Looking for you. You didn't tell anyone where you were going.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: Oh, sorry if I caused any problems, but Raley and the others worry too much. I'm fine.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: Yes. I just need to gather some camphor wood and then I'll head back to town. I'd have done so already if it wasn't for this damn injury!

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.player: You should really still be recovering. Do you need the wood now?

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: Yes! I need a new spear!

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.player: This is about that ship isn't it? The one with the red sails? You know that ship, don't you?

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: Yes. It's part of a fleet owned by the Red Reef Trading Company. I was the navigator for their flagship, the Zenith.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: I thought they were my friends, but not a single one of them dared say a word! They just stood there and watched that monster stab me with my own spear!

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: Do you know what he said as he did it? He said he was sorry! He said it wasn't personal! The worst part is, I think he believed it. To him, it was just the unfortunate cost of business!

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: Spencer Brentwood. He owns the company. Whatever it is they're up to, he's the one responsible.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.player: I'm sorry, Floopa. I can't even begin to imagine what you're going through, but you can't face this alone. Even if you weren't injured, this is too big for one person to deal with.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: Maybe, but it doesn't matter. I have to be the one to stop him.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.player: Fine, but at least let me help in other ways. We don't even know what it is that he's doing. Let me investigate. In the meantime, you can work on your recovery.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: You know, it's annoying that you keep talking sense.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: Alright, we'll do it your way, for now.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.player: Thank you, Floopa. Now, if I were to investigate this company, where would it be best for me to begin?

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: You'll want to sail to their headquarters: Red Rock. It's to the west of here, in the Red Reef.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.player: I'll head over there right away and pose as a new recruit. I'll be back once I've learnt something. Now, you should head back to Raley.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: Fine, but don't go taking too long.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.player: And risk you trying to sort things out on your own again? Don't worry, I'll be back before you know it.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa.text: Good luck, [player name], and... thank you.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa-.speaker: Floopa
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa-.text: I'll head back to Raley soon. I just need a little time to myself. You should get sailing over to Red Rock. It's to the west of here, in the Red Reef.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-floopa-.player: Alright. I'll be back before you know it.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-r.speaker: Elder Raley
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-r.text: Welcome back, [player name]. Any luck finding Floopa?

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-r.player: I found her over in the Sacred Grove. She should be back soon.

the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-r.speaker: Elder Raley
the-search-for-floopa-talking-to-elder-r.text: Thank you. She really shouldn't go wandering off while she's still recovering. I'll need to make sure her antics haven't reopened her wound.

on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton-b.speaker: Theodore Paxton
on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton-b.text: I don't seem to recall inviting you into my office. I'm a very busy man, so please be on your way.

on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.speaker: Receptionist
on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.text: Hello and welcome to Red Rock, home of the Red Reef Trading Company. How can I help you?

on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.player: I was actually thinking I might be able to help you.

on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.speaker: Receptionist
on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.text: You're looking for a job? Well, you've come to the right place! The Red Reef Trading Company is more than just a regular employer! We're a family!

on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.player: Great! Strong family connections are exactly what I look for in an employer. When you have those, why care about benefits and compensation?

on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.speaker: Receptionist
on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.text: You're so right. I can just tell that you're the kind of person who will love our company values, or as we call them, the Pillars of Progress! So tell me, what kind of work have you done in the past?

on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.player: Well, I imagine a company like this always has need of people who can solve problems, and I myself am something of a problem solver.
Sort of, but my problem solving abilities aren't just limited to the sea.

on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.speaker: Receptionist
on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.text: Now that's the can do attitude that we like here! My superior, Theodore Paxton, has been looking for someone to help him deal with a little issue. I think you might be just the person he needs!

on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.player: In that case, I'd be quite keen to speak with him.

on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.speaker: Receptionist
on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.text: Excellent! He should be free very soon. While you wait, may I recommend you familiarise yourself with the wonderful history of our company?

on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.speaker: Receptionist
on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.text: Fantastic! The display cases in this room should have all the details you need. You'll want to start with the one directly to the right of the entrance and then work your way around, ending with the ones behind me.

on-red-rock-talking-to-the-receptionist.player: I'll do just that. Thank you.

on-red-rock-before-looking-at-all-four-d.speaker: Receptionist
on-red-rock-before-looking-at-all-four-d.text: Mr Paxton will be with you shortly. While you wait, may I recommend you use the display cases to familiarise yourself with our company?

on-red-rock-before-looking-at-all-four-d.speaker: Receptionist
on-red-rock-before-looking-at-all-four-d.text: You'll want to start with the one directly behind you and then work your way around, ending with the ones behind me.

on-red-rock-before-looking-at-all-four-d.player: I'll take a look. Thank you.

on-red-rock-after-looking-at-all-four-di.speaker: Receptionist
on-red-rock-after-looking-at-all-four-di.text: Mr Paxton will see you now. He's waiting in his office.

on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton.speaker: Theodore Paxton
on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton.text: So, I hear you're someone who can solve problems?

on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton.speaker: Theodore Paxton
on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton.text: Good. A pirate captain by the name of Black Eye Bethel has been attacking our ships. Our understanding is that she has a hideout at Last Light to the south of here.

on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton.speaker: Theodore Paxton
on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton.text: Sail over there and put an end to her and her ships.

on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton.speaker: Theodore Paxton
on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton.text: Yes. Do well here and I might have more work for you. Now, if you have no further questions, I have a lot of work to do, so please be on your way.

on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton-a.player: What did you need me to do again?

on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton-a.speaker: Theodore Paxton
on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton-a.text: Black Eye Bethel has a hideout at Last Light to the south of here. Sail over there and put an end to her and her ships.

on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton-a.speaker: Theodore Paxton
on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-paxton-a.text: Now, if that's everything, I have a lot of work to do, so please be on your way.

the-pirates-of-last-light-when-approachi.text: As you approach the island, you spot some pirate boats circling.

the-pirates-of-last-light-sailing-away-f.text: You manage to sail away from the pirates, ending up somewhere [north/east/south/west] of Last Light.

the-pirates-of-last-light-after-sinking-.text: With the pirate boats sunk, you can now deal with the pirates on Last Light.

the-pirates-of-last-light-when-reaching-.speaker: Black Eye Bethel
the-pirates-of-last-light-when-reaching-.text: Looks like we've got some fresh meat!

steps.speaker: Black Eye Bethel
steps.text: Dodge this!

steps.speaker: Black Eye Bethel
steps.text: It's slashin' time!

steps.speaker: Black Eye Bethel
steps.text: You're done!

the-pirates-of-last-light-the-battle-aga.speaker: Black Eye Bethel
the-pirates-of-last-light-the-battle-aga.text: Let's see if you can handle this!
If the player does not have a dragon scimitar equipped:

steps.speaker: Black Eye Bethel
steps.text: I stole this one from a monkey!

the-pirates-of-last-light-the-battle-aga.text: If the player has a dragon scimitar equipped:

steps.speaker: Black Eye Bethel
steps.text: Nice scimitar! I've got one too!

steps.speaker: Black Eye Bethel
steps.text: No god can save you from me!

steps.speaker: Black Eye Bethel
steps.text: Fight me properly, coward!

steps.speaker: Black Eye Bethel
steps.text: Even praying won't help you now!

the-pirates-of-last-light-the-battle-aga.text: Your protection prayers have been disabled!

the-pirates-of-last-light-freeing-the-pa.text: You open the cage and free the parrot. It flies away, squawking happily as it does.

back-on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-pax.speaker: Theodore Paxton
back-on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-pax.text: Good. It's nice to have someone around who can get things done. Consider me impressed.

back-on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-pax.player: Does that mean you have more work for me?

back-on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-pax.speaker: Theodore Paxton
back-on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-pax.text: Me? No. However, the boss has an issue that has been proving tricky to solve. I think you might be just the kind of person he needs.

back-on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-pax.speaker: Theodore Paxton
back-on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-pax.text: I'll let him be the one to tell you that. He's out doing some work in the middle of the Red Reef at the moment. Sail out there and find his ship, the Zenith. It's easy to spot, so you shouldn't miss it.

back-on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-pax.player: What did you need me to do again?

back-on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-pax.speaker: Theodore Paxton
back-on-red-rock-talking-to-theodore-pax.text: You've got a meeting with the boss. He's out doing some work in the middle of the Red Reef at the moment. Sail out there and find his ship, the Zenith. It's easy to spot, so you shouldn't miss it.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.text: Hello! Welcome! You must be our friend who has a knack for solving problems.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.player: That's right. [player name]. Pleased to meet you.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.text: The pleasure is all mine. As you've probably already guessed, I'm Spencer Brentwood, and this is the Zenith.
If the player doesn't have diving equipment on them:

steps.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
steps.text: The best. Now, tell me, [player name], do you dive?

steps.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
steps.text: Underwater. I have some coral dredgers in need of repair.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.text: If the player has diving equipment or a medallion of the deep on them:

steps.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
steps.text: The best. Now, [player name], I see you have some diving equipment, so I'm assuming you dive?

steps.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
steps.text: I'm about to go diving myself. I have some coral dredgers in need of repair.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.text: Of course. It would be a poor leader who left all the work to their subordinates.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.text: A trait that is far too rare these days. More and more I find our work to be a beacon of light in this dark world.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.text: The future of humanity, of course. I've long believed our salvation lies beneath the waves. Indeed, I myself feel far more alive below the sea than above it. I'd be very keen to show you.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.player: Well, I suppose I can't say no to that.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.text: If the player doesn't have diving equipment on them:

steps.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
steps.text: Excellent! I have some diving gear here that you can use. Put it on and then let me know when you're ready.
Spencer gives you some diving equipment.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.text: If the player has diving equipment or a medallion of the deep equipped or on them:

steps.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
steps.text: Excellent! Get your diving equipment on and then let me know when you're ready.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-bre.text: If the player has no diving equipment and not enough inventory space:

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-aga.text: If the player doesn't have diving equipment:

steps.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
steps.text: I have some diving gear here that you can use. Put it on and then let me know when you're ready.
Spencer gives you some diving equipment.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-aga.text: If the player has diving equipment or a medallion of the deep in their inventory:

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-aga.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-aga.text: Get your diving equipment on and then let me know when you're ready.
If the player is wearing diving equipment or a medallion of the deep:

steps.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
steps.text: Are you ready to go diving?

options.text: I just need to sort something else out first.

steps.player: I just need to sort something else out first.

steps.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
steps.text: Very well.

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-aga.text: If the player has no diving equipment and not enough inventory space:

aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-aga.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
aboard-the-zenith-talking-to-spencer-aga.text: Shall we return to the seabed?

underwater-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer.text: Beautiful down here, isn't it? It's sad to think that most people will never see the wonders that exist here, but hopefully they can still benefit from them all the same.

underwater-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer.text: And right here we have one of those many wonders...
Spencer reaches into the coral dredger and takes out some red coral.

underwater-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer.text: The stuff of dreams... Quite literally. We're at the point now where my whole company is built on this stuff, though truth be told, I don't consider it anywhere near as big of a wonder as others do.

underwater-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer.text: The mages claim this stuff grants them dreams of the future. We've been supplying it to them for years, but despite that, all their dreams remain nothing more than that.

underwater-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer.text: I'm not here to be a mere dreamer. I'm here to turn dreams into reality.

underwater-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer.text: I find wealth to often be so distracting, and yet it is a sad necessity. Most simply hoard it, but for those of us lucky enough to find success, I believe it is our duty to use that wealth for good.

underwater-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer.text: Red coral is lucrative... Very lucrative. I need the money it makes to continue my work in other areas. Ironically, without red coral, my dreams will never come true.

underwater-talking-to-spencer.player: And that's why I'm here? To help realise your dreams?

underwater-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer.text: I have a complicated issue that must be solved. It may be that you are the one capable of doing so.

underwater-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer.text: If money is all you care for, then rest assured you will be paid handsomely. However, my hope for you, as with everyone I work with, is that you will also share in my dream as well.

underwater-talking-to-spencer.player: I'm open to that, given time.

underwater-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer.text: Wonderful! Sadly, the same can't be said for the sea life here. They are rather insistant on damaging these dredgers.

underwater-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer.text: We will discuss the nitty-gritty of the work I have for you later. First, let's get these fixed. I'll get this one sorted and then deal with the one to the east. Do you mind fixing the northern one?
Spencer fixes the coral dredger before moving on to the next one.

underwater-talking-to-spencer-again-befo.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-talking-to-spencer-again-befo.text: Have you sorted that dredger out yet?

underwater-talking-to-spencer-again-befo.player: Not yet. I'll get to it now.

underwater-repairing-the-dredger.text: The dredger is mostly in good order, but some pieces have become detached. You put them back into place again.

underwater-returning-to-spencer.player: That dredger is all sorted now.

underwater-returning-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
underwater-returning-to-spencer.text: Excellent! I'll just get this one finished, and then we can head back to the surface...
Spencer fixes the coral dredger and the two of you return to the surface.

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.text: Right, let's get down to brass tacks shall we?

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.text: The job. It's a delicate situation, and I must admit it has already led to some regrettable circumstances. However, this work is essential.

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.text: The Red Reef isn't as red as the name suggests. Despite our best attempts, we've reached a point where it can no longer supply the amount of red coral we need. A new source is needed.

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.player: And you want me to find this source?

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.text: No need! We already have one. After some extensive searches, we found a large reef in the Pearl Bank that should nicely suit our purposes. Our issue instead revolves around the inhabitants of that area...

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.text: How familiar are you with tortugans?

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.text: A remarkable race, but they are sadly very stubborn and stuck in their ways. There is an island in the Pearl Bank of great importance to them. They'd never allow an operation like ours so close to it.

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.text: Our attempts to remove them from the island haven't produced results so far. My hope is that you will have better luck. I'd like you to come up with a plan for removing the tortugans from the area.

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.text: If possible, I would appreciate it if you could minimise bloodshed, but make no mistake, nothing can be off the table. The Pearl Bank must be acquired for the company. There can be no compromises.

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.player: I understand. I will get to work at once.

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.speaker: Spencer Brentwood
back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.text: Wonderful! Report to me at Red Rock once you have something. Until then, I wish you good luck.

back-on-the-surface-talking-to-spencer.player: Thank you. I'd best be on my way.

back-on-the-surface-attempting-to-board-.text: You have no reason to reboard the Zenith. You should return to the Great Conch instead.

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.player: I did. You were right Floopa, the Red Reef Trading Company were responsible for the attack on the Little Pearl.

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.speaker: Elder Raley
back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.text: I don't understand. Why would these humans have a problem with us?

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.player: They've found a reef near the island. They want to start dredging it for red coral, but they need you gone from the Little Pearl first.

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.speaker: Floopa
back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.text: Red coral? Of course! Spencer talks the good talk, but all he really cares about is money. Trusting him was the biggest mistake I ever made.

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.speaker: Elder Raley
back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.text: So what do we do? How can we stop him?

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.player: We don't need to rush. I've gained Spencer's trust and he has tasked me with coming up with a plan for getting you off the Little Pearl. That means time is on our side.

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.speaker: Elder Raley
back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.text: Ah, I see! Time for us to come up with a plan of our own. Very good, [player name]! Very good!

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.speaker: Elder Raley
back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.text: Yes, yes, we'll start right away. Keep checking in, [player name]. We'll let you know once we've come up with something.

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.speaker: Elder Raley
back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.text: In the meantime, Floopa had a suggestion for a little way to thank you for all you've done for us.

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.speaker: Elder Raley
back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.text: Do you remember the camphor trees in the Sacred Grove? I've made some arrangements, and you now have permission to chop their wood. It's a much better place to do so than anywhere else on the island.

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.speaker: Elder Raley
back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.text: Oh, don't mention it. It's really no problem at all. You've been a good friend to us, [player name]. It means everything.

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.speaker: Floopa
back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.text: Yes, thank you, [player name]. I know I've been a bit... difficult in all of this, but even though I'm terrible at showing it, I really do appreciate everything you've done.

back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.speaker: Elder Raley
back-on-the-great-conch-talking-to-floop.text: Now, before you go I had something to give you that you might find useful.
If the player doesn't have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Elder Raley
steps.text: You don't seem to have space for it, come back when you do.
